summary.text: Generating a multi-party iMessage conversation with speaker labels, timing, and content constraints while separating speaker label from in-message references.
Resolving relative dates against the current timestamp while anchoring the new venue and attendee.
Extending the dialogue to confirm the noon Friday venue and participant commitments.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: morning guys, stealing this from my dms for a sec so leo can see it
Me: oh good idea, morning
Leo: morning, whats up
Maya: so you and i were talking about rosa's right
Me: yeah the one on oak street
Maya: exactly, we said friday next week at noon
Leo: ohh rosa's on oak street?
Me: yeah we already locked in noon for friday next week
Maya: do you wanna join us? its the same plan, not a separate thing
Leo: yes please, i wanna come too
Me: perfect, more cheese pull critics
Leo: lol always
Maya: yay okay so its us three then for that one
Leo: wait friday next week, not this friday?
Me: yeah next week, not this friday
Maya: yep friday next week at noon, same outing we talked about
Leo: yeah that works for me too
Me: nice
Maya: you good with rosa's on oak street?
Leo: yeah that works, never been but im in
Me: their crust is supposed to be really good
Maya: and no salty olive situation i promise
Leo: thank god lol never again
Me: haha still traumatized from mario's
Leo: that salt bomb killed me
Maya: luigi's last week was way better tho
Me: yeah the parmesan knots were elite
Leo: the cheese pull was solid too
Maya: ok rosa's has to live up to that now
Leo: pressure is on
Me: did you bus to luigi's ok last time?
Maya: yeah bus was actually fast, hoping same for oak street
Me: i can walk from work again, its pretty close
Leo: parking over there awful?
Maya: i think its better than pine street was
Me: way better, you wont have to circle forever
Leo: good cuz i circled forever for mario's
Maya: lol poor soldier
Leo: hey my sink is actually clear this morning btw
Me: no way, for real?
Maya: proud of you, how long will it last
Leo: rude but accurate, probably till tonight
Me: new record is four days, beat that
Leo: ill try, dishes tonight with the sketch on
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Me: hahaha its still stuck in my head
Leo: crying suit guy lives on forever
Maya: i said it at the gym yesterday lol
Me: morning gym again? leg day?
Maya: ugh no, arms today, legs are still dead from monday
Leo: never go back to leg day
Me: lol exactly
Leo: did IT ever fix your laptop btw?
Maya: nope still ghosted, froze twice yesterday
Me: mine was dragging all morning too
Leo: same, did the restart thing twice already
Maya: classic toolkit fail
Me: i just got to my desk and its already slow
Leo: morning coffee saving me rn
Maya: im on tea, need to warm up, office is freezing
Me: same, wore the heavy jacket in again
Leo: fall jacket uniform continues
Maya: inside is cold too ugh
Me: chamomile later for me please virtually lol
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: so you definitely good for noon?
Leo: yeah noon works for me
Maya: perfect, same as we planned in dms
Me: yeah same plan just plus leo now
Leo: love that, same outing, no extra planning chaos
Maya: exactly, i didnt want two pizza threads
Me: good call bringing it here
Leo: are we meeting out front like last time?
Maya: yeah out front works for me
Me: yeah that works for me too
Leo: bet, ill text when im close
Maya: same, ill bus over after gym
Me: ill walk over, like 10 mins
Leo: cant wait, need pizza to look forward to
Maya: same, this week is dragging already
Me: tuesday feels like monday part two
Leo: fr tho, morning meetings killed me
Maya: i have laundry exploding at home again
Me: join the club, mine never left the dryer
Leo: mine made it out then right back in, ecosystem reboot
Maya: but for clothes lol
Me: rude but accurate
Leo: hey are we doing the cooking game tonight?
Maya: maybe one round, depends how sore i am
Me: i could do one, no promises i wont burn stuff
Leo: two fires max, house rule
Maya: hey thats my rule
Me: lol she owns it now",
  "writer_note": "Brought the DM plan into the group via Maya referencing her side chat with the user, kept Rosa's on Oak Street at noon Friday next week as the single shared outing Leo joins, and wrapped it in normal morning work, tea, gym, and laptop chatter to match their voices."
}
